description:
Returns the user's career journal entries from GigHQ, newest first. Supports optional filtering by entry type and date range.

Use this tool to:
  - Review what the user has already documented before starting a journaling session
  - Find entries to update or refine
  - Identify gaps (roles with few or no entries)
  - Synthesise entries into resume bullets or interview stories

Entry type filter values: 1=achievement, 2=project, 3=skill_acquired, 4=reflection.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 end date to filter entries on or before, e.g. '2024-12-31'.

skip.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 start date to filter entries on or after, e.g. '2024-01-01'.

take.description: Number of entries to return (default 25, max 100).

type.description: Filter by entry type: 1=achievement, 2=project, 3=skill_acquired, 4=reflection. Omit for all types.

name: list_career_entries
